summary: No hot-path or throughput regression. The change only alters the terminality of an already-computed denial and its routing; there is no new per-turn work on the success path. The one added storage operation is the updated_at-CAS job access_requirement append, which runs only once when a human approves an under-declared tool from the card, with a bounded single re-read+retry on conflict. A denied-tool pause resolves immediately (zero-timeout autonomous protocol unchanged) rather than blocking a worker while burning time/tokens, which is a net efficiency gain over the prior silent-wrong-completion behavior.
non_blocking_findings: The requirement append uses optimistic concurrency with SETUP_REQUIREMENT_CAS_RETRY_LIMIT=1 (two attempts); on exhausted retries it logs and settles on the durable grant rather than looping.
